notes: Captured 2026-09-18 on joe. The menu half is a PRE-HELPER capture: the 16 stills came from a prototype C tool reading the menu VOBs through libdvdread and ffmpeg rendering one frame each, so there is no menus/structure.json and the still ids are ffmpeg's frame order (menu_01...menu_16) rather than menu PGC ids. Re-capture with Tools/capture-disc.sh v2 to get structure.json, PGC-named stills and the tier-1 expectations (playButtonTitle and friends), which are null here for that reason. The stills themselves are not committed: they are copyrighted menu artwork and docs/menu-intelligence.md 8.7 leaves that decision to the user; menus/ocr.json is enough for every invariant below. discId is lsdvd's, recovered by hand from the capture that recorded null because a bare `lsdvd` was not on the non-interactive ssh PATH. REVIEWED 2026-09-18: expect.menu was checked line by line against the 16 stills (all 23 chapter names, the languages page, and the title-card misread 'Bloodiport'). audioTrackCount and subtitleGroupCount are still unfilled and are skipped rather than asserted.

menu.notes: The subtitle list is what the CURRENT MenuOCR.Settings read, not what the page prints. The page prints four subtitle entries — English, Français, 日本語, Off — and Vision reads only three of them either way: with the §1.3 language list it reads 日本語 and drops 'Off'; with its defaults (English only) it reads 'off' and drops 日本語 entirely. This is exactly the kind of finding the archive exists for, and it is recorded rather than papered over; the expectation follows the settings the app actually uses so a settings change shows up here as a red test.
